  [C1] Incident Notice: CF Ethereum Real-Time Index (ETHUSD_RTI) – Calculation Interruption
Issued by: CF Benchmarks
Published: 2026-11-01T23:41:00+00:00

CF BENCHMARKS LTD
INDEX OPERATIONS – INCIDENT NOTICE

Index affected: CF Ethereum Real-Time Index (ERTI), ticker ETHUSD_RTI
Incident reference: OPS-2026-1101-03
Status: Investigating

At approximately 22:51:20 UTC on 1 November 2026, the calculation engine for the CF Ethereum Real-Time Index stopped disseminating index values. The interruption is linked to a fault in the ingestion of order book data from constituent exchanges. Dissemination resumed at approximately 23:07:45 UTC.

No ETHUSD_RTI values were published for the interval 22:51:20 UTC to 23:07:45 UTC. Values disseminated for this interval through data feeds, the website and the API show as null.

Index Operations is reviewing whether the index can be recalculated for the affected interval from archived constituent data, in line with the CF Benchmarks Methodology Change and Exceptional Event Policy. Clients should not treat any value for the affected interval as published until CF Benchmarks issues a further notice.

A further update will follow.

CF Benchmarks Index Operations

This update follows the notice of 1 November 2026 about the interruption to ETHUSD_RTI dissemination between 22:51:20 UTC and 23:07:45 UTC on 1 November 2026.

Index Operations has finished its initial review of archived constituent data for the affected interval. Data from one or more constituent exchanges for part of the interval could not be fully validated. The matter has been referred to the CF Benchmarks Oversight Function.

As of this update, CF Benchmarks has not published any recalculated or restated ETHUSD_RTI values for the affected interval. The interval stays NULL in all CF Benchmarks data products. CF Benchmarks cannot yet say whether or when values for the interval will be published.
